gc_guide.text: Glenveagh Castle, finished in 1873 for John George Adair. Twelve years before, he'd evicted his tenants from the glen in the middle of winter. People here have long memories, and they're right to.
Later owners were kinder. The last, Henry McIlhenny from Philadelphia, filled it with art and flowers, and in the end gave it to the nation, gardens and all.

gc_gardener.text: The walled garden has vegetables and roses; the pleasure grounds have trees from Chile and Tasmania. The deer would have the lot if we let them. We don't let them. They try.
